t: THE MYSTERIES OF THE LIFE OF CHRIST OUR LORD › OF THE THIRTEENTH APPARITION

items.e: First Epistle to the Corinthians, Chapter 15 [8]. He appeared to St. Paul after the Ascension. “‘Last of all, He appeared to me, as one born out of due time.’”
He appeared also in soul to the Holy Fathers of Limbo, and after taking them out and having taken His Body again, He appeared to the Disciples many times, and dealt with them.
